svg.title: Cloud Reliability Lab — how the technology connects
svg.desc: A public static learning site is separate from private OCI inference. Approved users enter through Bastion. The FastAPI gateway talks to llama.cpp and SQLite, exposes private Prometheus metrics, and can export bounded OpenTelemetry spans to Always Free APM. A host-side reliability runner uses narrow instance permissions and Vault secrets for encrypted Object Storage backups, isolated restore checks and OCI Monitoring datapoints. Monitoring alarms notify the subscribed operator. Reviewed Terraform in Resource Manager provisions only supporting reliability resources, not the existing VM. Reliability integrations are deployment-gated; this diagram describes their architecture, not proof they are live.
svg.text: One private service. Four reliability paths.
Read the boundaries first. Colored arrows show data; dashed green lines show provisioning.
ChatGPT Sites · static HTML / CSS / JavaScript · animated lessons + reviewed release evidence
No user keys, model requests, database access or live operational telemetry. No connection to the private backend.
PRIVATE OCI PHOENIX · EXISTING A1 HOST
2 OCPU / 12 GB shared hardware · separate application containers and volumes
Real CPU prefill / decode · RAM KV cache
0.5 CPU / 2.5 GiB · one answer at a time
No stored question or answer text
Host-side reliability runner · Python / OCI SDK
Online snapshot → authenticated encryption → upload → isolated restore verification
Bounded probes / datapoints · no model call for health checks · no Docker socket in web app
Not a personal API key; not per-container identity
Bounded export; no prompts, answers or keys
Unique names · no public links · bounded retention
GET back → decrypt → compare → restore drill
Health · backup freshness · labeled test signal
REPRODUCE · GITHUB → REVIEWED TERRAFORM → OCI RESOURCE MANAGER
Plan → review exact additions → apply → inspect outputs → detect drift · protected state, no secrets in Git
Creates supporting bucket / alarm / topic / APM / identity resources. Does not recreate or resize the existing VM.
Evidence gates: restored data ≠ uploaded file · delivered alert ≠ configured rule · queryable trace ≠ export attempt
Architecture is explanatory. Consult the release evidence for each integration's actual verified state. CPU-only: no HBM or remote KV-transfer claim.
